feeds.title: City Auto Repair Blog
feeds.description: City Auto Repair opened its doors to Gainesville in 1981 to provide a one-stop shop for all automotive repairs. Growing up in the shop with her father, who started the business, Rachael became passionate about cars, but more so, about being able to help people. Today, Rachael carries on her father's legacy with her team at City Auto Repair by providing an experience that is authentic and sincere, where each client is treated like part of the family.

feeds.title: RI Automotive Blog
feeds.description: RI Automotive has been in business for over 20 years. RI Automotive services all makes and models of cars. They offer routine maintenance, emergency repairs, and custom upgrades. To keep up with the very latest in auto service and repair trends, check out Tampa, FL's RI Automotive's Blog page.

feeds.title: All County Auto Repair Blog
feeds.description: shop is owned by Steve Rich, who has been working on cars since he was a teenager. All County Auto Repair offers a variety of services, including auto AC repair, tire services, and oil changes. They specialize in both domestic and import vehicles. The blog discusses what services are available and how to find a good auto repair shop.

feeds.title: AAMCO Central Florida Blog
feeds.description: AAMCO has been the leading professional in transmission rebuilds, repairs, and replacements. All of the AAMCO Central Florida service centers are locally owned and operated and can provide financing options if needed. AAMCO Central Florida has answers to your auto repair & maintenance questions, tips, advice, and stories from seasoned expert mechanics, industry experts, and auto enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Florida High Risk Auto Insurance Blog
feeds.description: Staybull Insurance provides auto insurance all across the state of Florida for individuals considered to be high-risk. The company is an independent agency that can quote your high-risk auto insurance with many major Florida carriers to find you the best rate for your particular situation. Find the latest blog post on Florida high-risk auto insurance here.

feeds.title: The Engine Block
feeds.description: The Engine Block's passion is the automotive aftermarket and anything that drives it. If you are an automotive enthusiast and share the passion, welcome aboard.

feeds.title: USA Auto Glass Blog
feeds.description: USA Auto Glass, Inc. is a locally owned and -operated company managed by partners who deliver more than 40 years of combined professional experience to your door - be it your office door, car door, or front door. The company offers a variety of services, including windshield repair and replacement, auto glass repair, power window and lock repair, sunroof repair, RV glass repair, boat windshield replacement, and heavy equipment glass repair.

feeds.title: Central Florida International Auto Show Blog
feeds.description: Central Florida International Auto Show Blog is all about the Central Florida International Auto Show. It discusses the dates and times of the show, as well as what to expect. The show will feature new cars, trucks, and SUVs.

feeds.title: El Car Wash Florida Blog
feeds.description: El Car Wash was founded in 2011 and is based in Miami, Florida. It has over 35 operating locations and plans to open 35 more. The company offers unlimited wash memberships, high-quality products, and leading customer service.

feeds.title: Naples Dodge Chrysler Jeep Ram Blog
feeds.description: Naples, FL car dealership has a premium selection of New Cars, Trucks, Crossovers, and SUVs from several beloved American brands. They have always exciting new models at the Naples dealership. If there's a particular model you have your eye on, check out the online inventory to make sure that they have it in stock. The site has the most current information on the current selection of new models.

feeds.title: Hialeah Auto Care Center Blog
feeds.description: At Hialeah Auto Care Center, the team is proud to provide customers with quality auto service solutions that increase their vehicle's reliability while keeping them safe on the road. Whether there's an issue with your check engine light, transmission system, or brake system, the team is here to help ensure you leave and get back on the road with a fully functional vehicle that you can trust to get you where you need to go.
